name: Account Suspension (Demo Pitch)
message: Your bank account will be blocked today. Call customer support immediately and pay ₹1,999 to verify your account.
reason: Account verification charge to prevent permanent blocking
description: Simulates aggressive pressure and extortion under the guise of an account lockdown.

name: Fake Customer Support
message: Hello, I am executive Rakesh from Payment Support. We noticed an unauthorized debit of ₹14,000 on your account. Send ₹500 token fee to our support UPI to cancel the order immediately.
description: Impersonates customer care agent asking user to transfer funds to 'cancel' a fictitious transaction.

name: Fake Refund via QR Code
message: Dear Customer, an excess transaction refund of ₹4,999 is approved. Scan this QR code and enter your UPI PIN to instantly receive the refund in your bank account.
description: Classic reverse-charge trick deceiving users into believing scanning a QR or entering PIN receives funds.

name: Prize / Lottery Scam
message: Congratulations! You have been selected as the 1st prize winner of ₹50,000 in our Annual Diwali Lucky Draw! Pay ₹499 registration processing fee immediately to claim your prize.
description: Advance-fee fraud exploiting false celebration to extract non-refundable processing charges.

name: Fake Shopping Storefront
message: Mega Warehouse Clearance! Brand new iPhone 15 Pro for only ₹14,999 (90% off)! Offer expires in 20 minutes. Order now at http://192.168.1.105/apple-deal and pay via UPI.
description: Unrealistic discount hosted on an insecure IP address creating artificial urgency.

name: Legitimate Electricity Bill
message: Dear Consumer, your electricity bill for Account #982138 for amount ₹820 is due on 15 Oct. Please pay via your registered electricity provider portal or authorized bank app.
description: Routine factual billing notice from a recognized state utility advising payment through official channels.
